verdict.rationale: Vue ships official first-party libraries (Vue Router, Pinia) and rich docs/tutorials that an AI-native developer could build against, and the presence of a dedicated llms.txt endpoint suggests some AI-native accessibility. However there is no evidence of dedicated 'SDK' packages (e.g., API client libraries), no OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404s), and no explicit AI-agent tooling or SDK versioning story. Missing for 10: explicit official SDK packages beyond core framework libraries, evidence of AI-specific SDK documentation or tooling, independent confirmation of AI-native usability.
